description_en: Calls the UpdateResourceGroupAttribute operation to transfer an instance to a new resource group
description_zh: 调用UpdateResourceGroupAttribute接口将实例转移至新的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun drds update-resource-group-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --drds-instance-id drds00000000000 --new-resource-group-id rg-000000000000000 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateResourceGroupAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the target instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/139284.html operation to query the details of instances under your account, including the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/139284.html接口查看账号下的实例详情，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the target instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/139284.html operation to query the details of instances under your account, including the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/139284.html接口查看账号下的实例详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: drds_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the target resource group.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html operation to query the details of resource groups, including the resource group ID
parameters.help_zh:
目标资源组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html接口查看资源组详情，包括资源组ID
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id
